cases.obligation: Learning is the sole writer of AdaptiveLearningPolicyVersion.
Learning is the sole writer of AdaptiveDecisionTrace.
Curriculum InstructionalPolicyVersion remains Curriculum-owned.
Learner Model remains read/synthesis input and cannot write next-action state.
Chat/LLM transport cannot become next-action policy authority.
Core/runtime/analytics cannot select canonical next action.
Shared Assurance remains authority for model calibration standing.
Generic scheduler/job state cannot write adaptive learner decisions.
Prerequisite failure makes the candidate ineligible before ranking.
Assessment-integrity restriction makes the conflicting candidate ineligible.
Curriculum instructional-policy restriction makes the conflicting tutoring action ineligible.
Authorization or safety denial makes the candidate ineligible.
Required stale or incompatible Curriculum version blocks or explicitly degrades eligibility.
Required unresolved remediation blocks incompatible advancement.
No model score can promote an ineligible candidate.
Every ineligible candidate records exact blocker reasons and policy/input versions.
Weak evidence coverage can trigger evidence-gathering rather than automatic advancement.
Stale retention standing can trigger revalidation.
Missing transfer evidence can trigger a materially novel application task.
Supported success can trigger a reduced-support attempt only when independence is part of the construct.
Evidence diversity can outrank repetition of near-identical items.
Immediate correctness alone cannot be the universal ranking objective.
Completion speed alone cannot be the universal ranking objective.
Session length, clicks, messages, streaks or content volume cannot be default mastery-sequencing objectives.
UNKNOWN critical state remains explicit and is not interpreted as favorable eligibility.
STALE critical state cannot be silently treated as current.
CONTRADICTED evidence can trigger reconciliation or additional evidence rather than silent averaging.
Insufficient evidence can produce an information-gathering action instead of a low-mastery label.
Learner Model inference cannot silently satisfy prerequisite or mastery eligibility.
Confidence/effort/confusion/task-value context cannot independently establish competence.
Missing dependency standing fails closed where the action requires that dependency.
Identical exact deterministic inputs produce identical eligibility sets and reason codes.
001H selects the next learning action while 001F controls how the tutor teaches within that action.
Next-action policy cannot bypass Curriculum direct-answer restrictions.
Next-action policy cannot bypass assessment-specific tutoring restrictions.
A generated tutor response cannot itself create a new eligible action outside policy.
A self-regulation checkpoint recommendation cannot become mastery evidence by itself.
Prompt reduction cannot automatically remove an authorized accommodation.
Tool/AI assistance interpretation follows the intended construct rather than a universal no-tool rule.
Instructional scaffold fading remains reversible under current learner context and policy.
Learner may choose among multiple policy-eligible alternatives where choice is allowed.
Learner may request an explanation of the recommendation.
Valid override references the exact recommendation and policy version.
Override to an ineligible action is denied with reason evidence.
Original recommendation trace remains immutable after override.
Override disposition is append-oriented and idempotent.
Learner override does not become competence evidence.
Repeated learner preference may influence ranking only inside policy and cannot erase required learning gates.
Predictive/generative ranking occurs only after deterministic eligibility.
Model identity/version and approved use are recorded when a model affects ranking.
Required calibration standing is checked before consequential model use.
ModelNotCalibrated invokes deterministic fallback when policy permits.
ModelNotCalibrated fails or degrades the action when no permitted fallback exists.
Model confidence cannot become mastery or eligibility truth.
Deterministic tie-break behavior is stable and recorded.
Model/provider/chat metadata cannot bypass prerequisite, Curriculum, safety or evidence gates.
Every durable recommendation has an immutable trace identity.
Trace binds exact adaptive policy and relevant input versions/digest.
Trace records eligible candidates and selection reasons.
Trace records rejected candidates and blocker reasons.
GetNextAction remains read-only and cannot silently create canonical state.
Same semantic operation plus same payload replays one decision.
Same operation identity plus conflicting payload fails deterministically.
Restart reconstructs current recommendation and override lineage from durable state.
No eligible candidate returns explicit NoEligibleAction rather than a fabricated next step.
Accessibility/accommodation is not penalized as learner dependence by default.
Protected/sensitive attributes are not default ranking inputs merely because predictive performance improves.
Only minimum learner data necessary for the declared decision purpose is consumed.
Changed executable bytes require fresh exact-subject qualification before PASS transfer.
Software qualification cannot be labeled proof of educational effectiveness.
Model calibration PASS cannot be labeled proof that sequencing improves learning.
Cumulative regression preserves 001D-001G ownership and authority fences with no second mastery, learner-model, tutoring or next-action writer.
